```python
import json
from pathlib import Path

import griffe

# `mod` is an already-loaded griffe module object.

# Serialize the module to a JSON string and write it to disk.
json_text = mod.as_json(full=True, indent=2)
Path("api.json").write_text(json_text, encoding="utf-8")

# Read the JSON text back and reconstruct an equivalent module object.
json_text = Path("api.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
reconstructed_mod = griffe.Module.from_json(json_text)

print(type(reconstructed_mod), reconstructed_mod.name)
```
